purpose: Prevent momentum-only qualification while separately validating pre-obvious and second-leg/re-acceleration opportunities.

chain_requirements.causal_mechanism_gate: order_probability >= 0.55 OR commissioning/capacity/product-approval evidence at stage >= 0.55
chain_requirements.technical_confirmation_role: confirmation only; it cannot make an otherwise failed chain pass

grade_logic.A: all causal-chain gates pass, primary evidence >=2, and at least two impact/conviction confirmations among financial inflection, catalyst magnitude, order probability, promoter/accumulation
grade_logic.B: all causal-chain gates pass with at least one impact/conviction confirmation
grade_logic.C: research only; incomplete external-demand or impact chain
grade_logic.REJECT: fails primary evidence, causal mechanism, or priced-in gate

note: Thresholds and sleeve rules frozen before historical V11.4 validation. Second-leg logic does not excuse a price run unless a fresh catalyst generation and remaining business upside are present.

pre_obvious_discovery.note: seek business inflection before broad rerating

second_leg_reacceleration.note: prior 50-100%+ run is allowed only when new primary evidence creates a fresh business leg

financial_context.role: validate business direction and acceleration without requiring the catalyst to have already appeared fully in reported earnings
